newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade near midday Wednesday was at a standstill following this week's sales, which nearly depleted showlists, market sources said. There were a few bids at $102.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, with owners that still had cattle to sell passing the bids and asking $103.00 to $104.00, they said.
This week's sales were pegged near 82,000 head, with a top of $103.00, down $3.00 from last week's top, although the bulk of last week's trade was at $105.50.
Showlists this week were estimated near 85,000 head, the sources said.
